model: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B NVFP4 + DSpark draft
speculative: DSPARK with nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4-DSpark draft, block size 3 (bf16 draft KV)
extra_setup: start.sh (or --download-only) downloads target + DSpark draft into $HF_HOME (~/.cache/huggingface) via hf/huggingface-cli or a docker fallback; container runs `sglang serve` with snapshot paths resolved from the HF cache.

measured.concurrency_notes: no tok/s published; ~4.93M-token FP8 KV pool (~14.1 GiB), max_running_requests 48 at mem-fraction 0.78

notes: Script defaults (MEM_FRACTION_STATIC=0.78, CUDA_GRAPH_MAX_BS_DECODE=4, DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE=3, HOST 0.0.0.0, PORT 8888). Hybrid 52 layers (23 Mamba-2, 23 MoE, 6 attention); native 1M context (1,048,576). README lists --kv-cache-dtype auto in its invocation but start.sh does not pass it (auto is the default; resolves to FP8 e4m3fn). MODEL_IN_CONTAINER/DRAFT_IN_CONTAINER are HF cache snapshot paths. Image tag unpinned dev tag.
